states.label: Start
states.description: Push the root board position.

states.label: Pop next position
states.description: Pop the highest-priority retained board position. A delimiter marks where the current batch ends.

states.label: Inspect position
states.description: Choose the next card from ordinary chess facts visible in the current position.

states.label: Our move
states.description: Scan the single ordered ordinary move card and retain at most the first five distinct matching legal moves. A check that newly defends a vulnerable back-rank entry square is ranked immediately before an ordinary loose-piece capture; the prepared capture itself uses the existing capture_undefended_non_pawn_piece predicate. If none proves the line, fail explicitly at the candidate-budget boundary.

states.label: Genuine replies to mate in one
states.description: Partition every legal opponent reply by the resulting board. Retain every reply after which our side has no legal mate in one. Every omitted reply must carry mate_in_1_available and at least one exact mating-move witness. Each retained defense returns to ordinary inspection.

states.label: Critical replies to the loose-alignment attack
states.description: Retain every recapture and every reply after which no legal capture immediately reaches the configured material objective. Every omitted non-recapture must carry material_objective_capture_in_1_available and at least one exact capture witness. Each retained reply returns to ordinary inspection.

states.label: Answer the check
states.description: A check earns a two-ply extension: the checking move and one answer. Prefer mate, recapture, capture, then checks ordered by one reply, two replies, and other checks, then any legal king response. This root-side choice card is hard-capped at five distinct candidates; exhausting those five fails loudly.

states.label: All replies
states.description: Enumerate every legal opponent reply whenever the visible policy requires exhaustive coverage. Captures and checks are ordered first, but every legal reply is retained.

states.label: Opponent final forcing shot after objective-backed material advantage
states.description: After the configured objective is reached and our side is not materially behind, retain every immediate mate, recapture, or check available to the opponent. If none exists, the position is quiet and the branch is proved.

states.label: Replies to an attacked piece
states.description: Consider ordinary ways to answer an attack: capture the attacker, move or defend the piece, block the attack, give a forcing check, or make a capture. Unmatched moves are quiet under this card’s explicit reply vocabulary.

states.label: Replies to a skewer
states.description: Consider ordinary ways to answer a skewer: capture the skewering piece, move or defend the skewered piece, block the line, give a forcing check, or make a capture. Unmatched moves are quiet under this card’s explicit reply vocabulary.

states.label: Replies while a defender is attacked
states.description: A non-pawn piece is attacked and has exactly one effective defender; our last move safely attacked that defender. Retain a bounded forcing check, a move that puts the defender on a safe square while it still defends the target, or a capture of either the chaser or the target’s original attacker. Other replies are the policy’s declared quiet boundary.

states.label: OUR MOVE TOP-5 EXHAUSTED
states.description: All five retained candidates from the current root-side choice card failed. Stop this line loudly instead of silently scanning lower-priority moves.

rules.label: OUR MOVE TOP-5 EXHAUSTED — every retained candidate from this root-side choice card failed; lower-priority moves were not searched

states.label: OUR MOVE NO MATCH
states.description: No legal move matched the current root-side choice card’s visible predicate list. Stop this line loudly.

rules.label: OUR MOVE NO MATCH — no legal move matched the current root-side choice card

states.label: Propagate proof
states.description: One successful candidate proves a choice frame. Every retained opponent reply must be discharged before a replies frame is proved.

rules.label: a chosen move worked; discard its unused alternatives
one opponent reply is discharged; examine the next
the root position is proved

states.label: Propagate failure
states.description: A failed candidate falls through to the next candidate. A failed opponent reply refutes the parent choice.

rules.label: this candidate failed; try the next candidate
an opponent reply refuted this candidate
the root position is not solved by this policy

states.label: Commit successful choice
states.description: Discard unused sibling moves until the choice delimiter, restore the ancestor, and propagate proof.

states.label: Abort refuted replies
states.description: Discard the remaining sibling replies until the replies delimiter, restore the ancestor, and propagate failure.

states.label: Solved
states.description: A root move worked against every retained opponent reply.

states.label: Failed loudly
states.description: Every candidate failed, or this basic policy could not narrow a required reply set.

proof.quiet_definition: Only a state named in quiet_closure_states may prove a branch because no listed quiet reply matched. Candidate patterns never prove a win by themselves: an explicit leaf must be mate or an objective-backed up_material position, a declared quiet reply boundary must close after every retained reply is discharged, or a forced closure must carry its declared complementary witness.
proof.forced_definition: Each forced closure partitions every legal opponent reply with explicit witnesses. Mate-threat replies with no legal mate in one are retained universally; every omitted reply has mate_in_1_available and an exact mate_in_1_move witness. Loose-alignment replies retain every recapture and every board with no immediate objective-winning capture; every omitted non-recapture has material_objective_capture_in_1_available and an exact material_objective_capture_in_1_move witness.
